description_en: Submits a shopping video OSS URL for intelligent recognition. The platform creates an asynchronous recognition task and immediately returns a task_id. Results are delivered through webhook notifications, and you can also call the query operation to retrieve results
description_zh: 用于智能识别场景， 需要上传购物视频 OSS 地址，平台创建异步识别任务并立即返回task_id, 通过webhook 通知，需要主动查询接口获取结果
kebab_example: aliyun agentretailvision recognize-order --order-unique-id ORDER_001 --video-urls https://oss.example.com/video1.mp4 --device-id DEVICE_001 --candidate-items 535c3daaadgaf5382db49a90969bc2d --callback-url https://example.com/callback --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeOrder

parameters.help_en: The unique idempotent ID of the caller. This ID must be unique within the same caller
parameters.help_zh: 业务方唯一幂等ID，同一业务方下唯一
parameters.name: order_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The list of shopping video OSS URLs. Currently, only one URL is supported
parameters.help_zh: 购物视频OSS地址列表（目前只支持一个）
parameters.name: video_urls

parameters.help_en: The list of candidate items. We recommend that you pass platform_item_id
parameters.name: candidate_items

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for this task. If not specified, the registered default address is used
parameters.help_zh: 本次任务回调地址；不传则使用已注册默认地址
parameters.name: callback_url

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is not returned for successful calls
Code.description_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数
Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
